slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS self-reported monitoring round. Burkina Faso appears only in the annex's score bands: digitization of the civil registration system under 35% (the lowest band, with 20 other countries), civil registration process 35-49%, overall system 35-49%. The country's own answers on electronic capture at local offices are not given, and no system is named.
